other_conditions: Applicant must have been residing in Haryana for at least 3 years at the time of application
Self‑income from all sources must not exceed the minimum wage for unskilled labour as notified by the Labour Department
Applicant must have one of the following disabilities: blindness, low vision, cured leprosy, hearing impairment, locomotor disability, intellectual disability (mental retardation), or mental illness
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month as a pension.
